RIGHT wife tall crooked asymmetrical splat, teal soft aviator hood with tiny mustard scarf and curling goo quiff. Huge tired WHITE eyes RED iris BLACK pupil look LEFT at husband, mouth long flat offended frown with TWO bottom teeth, yet her other hand protectively polishes a tiny matching copper heart clasp. Holds a small beaten coral suitcase against belly with blank cream luggage tag dangling in safe cell. Navigation pride vs exhausted travel partner, subtle remaining tenderness.
